capabilities: Generate flashcards and multiple-choice quizzes with AI
Schedule reviews with FSRS-7 stability, difficulty and fitted weights
Review cards in cloze, context, full-text recall, media and image occlusion modes
Forecast 30-day workload and cap overdue cards
Back up and restore review data as JSON or CSV
disambiguation: Not a code or writing review tool; it schedules spaced-repetition flashcards.
extras: Freemium: the free edition is unlimited in time but capped at 50 review notes and highlight cards combined; the paid edition only removes the cap. License keys are verified locally and offline, and bz Reader patron keys are accepted. The video tutorial is still in production.
intentEvidence: It was split out of bz — the original copy there stays untouched.
problem: Building and organizing flashcards by hand is slow, and fixed schedules ignore a learner's own review history.

relations.evidence: It was split out of bz — the original copy there stays untouched.

summary: Spaced-repetition flashcard plugin where AI builds and tidies cards, and FSRS-7 scheduling fits intervals to your own review history.
